title: Kenzy

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Snap crackle smack mother fucker. What's going on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Snap crackle smack mother fucker. What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Don't have to make sense to be rad. What's got yah yuckin' my yum anyhow?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't have to make sense to be rad. What's got yah yuckin' my yum anyhow?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Bout as good as a batch of screws in a grinder.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bout as good as a batch of screws in a grinder.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: So just another day, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So just another day, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Well, why the ever-loving riff waves didn't you say so? Come on! When and where?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, why the ever-loving riff waves didn't you say so? Come on! When and where?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Freya Portlet? That uppity Corp-jockey? She'd prolly die before she lets me play for one of her clubs. Don't exactly fit the bill.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Freya Portlet? That uppity Corp-jockey? She'd prolly die before she lets me play for one of her clubs. Don't exactly fit the bill.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Then why the fuck are you workin' for her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then why the fuck are you workin' for her?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Or - and I know this is a novel concept for you - you actually don't gotta.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or - and I know this is a novel concept for you - you actually don't gotta.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Tsk. Tsk. Spoken like one of them. I think I'm out. Good luck finding someone who wants to squeeze into Freya's little mold.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tsk. Tsk. Spoken like one of them. I think I'm out. Good luck finding someone who wants to squeeze into Freya's little mold.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Sure the tips will be good but I'll be sellin' my soul. I'll be playin' for people who don't vibe with the music and I ain't about that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure the tips will be good but I'll be sellin' my soul. I'll be playin' for people who don't vibe with the music and I ain't about that.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Ohhhhh, that would be sooooo many glow sticks. Fuck it, I'm in. Send me the details and I'll be there. I wonder if I could buy enough to fill the Silver Spoon's basement.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ohhhhh, that would be sooooo many glow sticks. Fuck it, I'm in. Send me the details and I'll be there. I wonder if I could buy enough to fill the Silver Spoon's basement.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I promise you: no compromises. Just big tips.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I promise you: no compromises. Just big tips.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I promise you: no compromises. Just big tips.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I promise you: no compromises. Just big tips.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Those words make no sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those words make no sense.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Life going good. How are you Kenzy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Life going good. How are you Kenzy?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Life going good. How are you Kenzy?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Life going good. How are you Kenzy?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm in a bind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm in a bind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds painful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds painful.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm looking for a headliner for an upcoming gig.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm looking for a headliner for an upcoming gig.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm looking for a headliner for an upcoming gig.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm looking for a headliner for an upcoming gig.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Calypso Island.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Calypso Island.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can guarantee she'll let you. Think about it: rich crowds, big tips?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can guarantee she'll let you. Think about it: rich crowds, big tips?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can guarantee she'll let you. Think about it: rich crowds, big tips?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can guarantee she'll let you. Think about it: rich crowds, big tips?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's not my favorite either.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's not my favorite either.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gotta play the game.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gotta play the game.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Unless you want to get ahead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unless you want to get ahead.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Unless you want to get ahead.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Unless you want to get ahead.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Think of all the glow sticks you could buy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Think of all the glow sticks you could buy.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Think of all the glow sticks you could buy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Think of all the glow sticks you could buy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Money's money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Money's money.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Freya wants new bands for her resorts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Freya wants new bands for her resorts.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Freya wants new bands for her resorts.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Freya wants new bands for her resorts.
